claim: Excavations at Mantai document long-distance exchange through imported ceramics, beads and plant products; the 2009–2010 sequence includes wares from India, China, Southeast Asia and the Middle East, while archaeobotanical finds include imported or exchanged products such as wheat, grape, black pepper and a clove.
bounded_by: Object provenance demonstrates exchange networks but does not by itself prove direct voyages from every origin region to Mantai; goods could move through multiple entrepôts.
notes: Use to prevent the sea-routes museum map from being read as evidence for direct point-to-point sailing.
